commands.name: search-jobs
commands.summary: Free-text search of Platsbanken job ads (title, employer, occupation, workplace, dates), sorted by relevance or date

commands.name: search-jobs-in-municipality
commands.summary: Free-text job search limited to one Swedish municipality (municipality ID from get-taxonomy-tree --type LOCATION)

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Full details of one job ad: HTML description, employer, workplace address, employment type, working hours, salary type, how to apply

commands.name: suggest-search-terms
commands.summary: Typeahead suggestions (completions) for a partial job-search query

commands.name: list-popular-occupations
commands.summary: Occupations with the most open job ads right now, with ad counts

commands.name: get-taxonomy-tree
commands.summary: Taxonomy tree with IDs used for search filters: LOCATION = regions (län) and their municipalities, OCCUPATION = occupation fields and groups
